The menu has "Send Key" with a submenu arrow, and "Send Ctrl-Alt-Del" right below it. Opening Task Manager in Windows usually means Ctrl-Alt-Del, which brings up the security screen. The annotation in the file preview also mentions "send keys to the VM to open task manager" with a bbox of [381, 395, 491, 414]. That bbox is in what looks like a normalized 0-1000 range, which would map to x≈0.381*1333... but the box is more likely a screen coordinate. The "Send Ctrl-Alt-Del" item sits at about (139, 156), and x=139 in the full image is roughly 0.104 of the width, which doesn't match. The bbox y 395–414 over 862 would be about 340–357, and "Send Key" is at y=148. These don't line up, so I'll go with the menu item.
